provenance.asset_description: The Functionary, artist Tom Ventre; A human woman with bright red skin and long white hair pulled into a ponytail smiles confidently at the viewer; she wears weather-worn armor, a bandana around her neck, and an intricate half-mask that covers the entire top half of her face and rises into a crown.
